title: PriceRecommendation
description: One constrained price suggestion for one variant. Written by the ML lane's optimizer (model_runs kind="recommendation") into `recommendations`, read by /api/recommend and the propose flow's Suggested prefill card. Suggestions never auto-apply: the merchant always approves (PRD v1.1). One row per (shop, variant, model_version); the freshest row wins.

current_price_cents.description: The live price the optimizer started from. If the storefront price has moved since `computed_at`, the recommendation is stale and must not be prefilled.

recommended_price_cents.description: Nominal optimum: argmax of expected profit on the rounding lattice within constraints, at the fitted elasticity point estimate.

robust_price_cents.description: Robust optimum: argmax of worst-case profit with elasticity at its pessimistic credible bound. Shown beside the nominal so the merchant sees what caution looks like; when the two agree the suggestion is sturdy.

rounding.description: The lattice the candidates were drawn from (lib/money.ts applyRounding endings).

elasticity.description: Point estimate used for the nominal objective, from the champion fit.

elasticity_low.description: Lower credible bound (CI80) used in the robust evaluation. Send with `elasticity_high` or not at all.

elasticity_high.description: Upper credible bound (CI80) used in the robust evaluation.

fit_model_version.description: model_version of the elasticity fit the objective was built on (R31 traceability).

confidence.description: Inherited from the underlying fit after staleness demotion. The propose flow only prefills `fitted`/`partial`; `assumption` rows exist for audit but are not surfaced.

robust_profit_delta_cents_per_day.description: Profit delta with elasticity at its pessimistic bound. May be negative even when the nominal is positive — that is the honesty the card shows, not a bug.

expected.description: Daily expected deltas at `recommended_price_cents` under the same demand model the forecast uses (units1 = units0 * (P1/P0)^elasticity). Integer cents per day; multiply by a horizon in the UI, never here.

margin_floor_pct.description: Minimum gross margin over cogs_cents, in percent. null = no floor applied.

max_change_pct.description: Cap on |price change| from current, in percent. null = uncapped.

inventory_cap_applied.description: True when a price cut's projected demand increase was capped by inventory_quantity (thin stock cannot serve the demand a deep cut buys).

binding.description: Which constraints the nominal optimum is pressed against. ['none'] means the optimum is interior.

candidates_evaluated.description: Size of the constrained lattice actually searched.

baseline_units_per_day.description: Demand baseline the deltas were computed from.

rationale.description: Plain-language, merchant-facing explanation: what the suggestion expects and which constraint bounds it. No statistics jargon (R25).

model_version.description: Matches model_runs.model_version (R31) — every number is traceable to the run that made it.
